requirement.description: {model_monica} proposed automated experiment tracking. The more automated it is, the better it supports reproducibility.
requirement.reading: The more automated it is, the better it supports reproducibility.

speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: I want more than basic automated experiment tracking. It needs to make every run reproducible and easier to compare.
output.correction: I am not saying the proposal is useless. I mean it should be treated as a reproducibility requirement, not a nice to have.
